zh.title: 空中巴士A350F完成地面震動測試 預計今年底前首飛
zh.summary: 空中巴士首架A350F貨機在法國土魯斯完成為期三天的地面震動測試，為預計於2026年底前進行的首飛做準備。此項測試旨在驗證飛機結構動態與氣動彈性模型。空中巴士預計該款基於A350-1000機型開發的貨機將於2027年投入營運。
body: 歐洲飛機製造商空中巴士（Airbus）宣佈，首架A350F貨機已在法國土魯斯完成地面震動測試（GVT）。此項測試為該機型地面測試計畫的重要里程碑，旨在為預計於2026年底前進行的首飛做準備。
本次地面震動測試於2026年6月進行，歷時三天，測試機型為MSN700。地面震動測試為飛機進行首飛前的必要驗證程序，主要目的在於量測機身結構對動態刺激的反應，並驗證飛機的氣動彈性行為是否符合設計階段所建立的數學模型。
在測試過程中，工程師透過連接於翼尖、後機身與發動機等處的外接震動器，結合飛機本身的控制面動作對機身進行震動刺激。資料採集則結合了飛機內建的飛行測試儀表（FTI）數據與專為測試安裝的自主感測器數據。
在此次地面震動測試之前，空中巴士已於德國不萊梅設施完成主艙門（MDCD）驅動與貨物裝載系統（CLS）的測試台演示。此外，測試團隊亦針對防尾傾保護、排水系統及最大載重能力等項目進行了多項地面評估。
A350F為基於A350-1000客機平台開發的全專用貨機，與廣體客機版本具備高度共通性，共享約90%的零組件。該款貨機設計最大酬載能力可達111公噸，主艙位最多可容納30個集裝板位置。
空中巴士預計A350F將於2026年底前完成首次飛行。隨著相關試飛與認證工作持續推進，該型貨機目前的商業營運時程規劃於2027年正式投入市場。

en.title: Airbus Completes Ground Vibration Testing on A350F Freighter Ahead of First Flight
en.summary: Airbus has completed ground vibration testing on its first A350F freighter test aircraft in Toulouse, France, marking a key milestone ahead of the type's planned first flight before the end of 2026. The three-day test campaign evaluated the airframe's structural dynamics and verified its aeroelastic behavior using sensors and shakers across the fuselage, wings, and engines. Based on the A350-1000 passenger aircraft, the A350F is designed to carry up to 111 tonnes of payload. Airbus currently expects the freighter to enter commercial service in 2027.
body: European aircraft manufacturer Airbus has completed ground vibration testing on the first A350F freighter test aircraft, marking a major technical milestone in the ground test campaign ahead of the aircraft's scheduled first flight before the end of 2026.

The testing campaign took place in Toulouse, France, over the course of three days in June 2026 on test aircraft MSN700. Ground vibration testing represents a critical evaluation to validate structural dynamics and aeroelastic behaviour before flight testing, ensuring that dynamic responses across the airframe match the mathematical models used during initial design.

During the test series, the aircraft airframe was excited using external hydraulic shakers connected at key positions—including the wingtips, rear fuselage, and engines—in combination with movements from the aircraft's own flight control surfaces. Engineers collected data through onboard Flight Test Instrumentation alongside autonomous sensors installed throughout the airframe.

The vibration trial follows months of extensive ground testing across Airbus facilities. Prior to the Toulouse campaign, Airbus conducted test rig demonstrations of the Main-Deck Cargo Door actuation system and Cargo Loading System at its facility in Bremen, Germany, alongside evaluations of drainage systems and maximum payload handling.

The A350F is a dedicated cargo derivative of the A350-1000 passenger airliner, sharing around 90 percent of its components with the baseline aircraft. The new freighter is designed to accommodate a payload of up to 111 tonnes across 30 main-deck pallet positions.

Airbus maintains its expectation for the A350F to perform its maiden flight before the end of 2026. Commercial entry into service for the freighter program is currently planned for 2027, when it will enter service for air cargo operators.

zh.title: 西班牙航空將派A321XLR執飛日全食觀測包機
zh.summary: 西班牙航空計劃於2026年8月12日派遣空中巴士A321XLR執飛IB1473特別包機，從馬德里巴拉哈斯國際機場（MAD）起飛，前往西班牙中北部帕倫西亞省上空觀測日全食。該航班將搭載Shelios計畫研究團隊，並透過SpaceX提供的Starlink衛星網路進行空中直播。
body: 西班牙航空計劃於2026年8月12日執飛一班特別包機，以觀測西班牙部分地區出現的日全食。該航班編號為IB1473，致敬16世紀波蘭天文學家哥白尼的出生年份，預計當地時間18時45分從馬德里巴拉哈斯國際機場起飛。
該任務將採用空中巴士A321XLR客機執飛，航線專門規劃於西班牙中北部的帕倫西亞省上空，飛行高度為10,000公尺。航班將載運由天文學家Miquel Serra-Ricart領導的Shelios計畫研究團隊，機組人員中的飛行員Javier Meana Fernández亦具備天體物理學背景。
此外，西班牙航空計劃透過社群媒體直播空中觀測過程。本次執飛任務的A321XLR客機為該航空公司首批配備SpaceX Starlink衛星網路連線功能的飛機之一。

en.title: Iberia to Operate Special A321XLR Solar Eclipse Flight with Starlink
en.summary: Spanish flag carrier Iberia plans to operate a special charter flight on August 12, 2026, to observe a total solar eclipse visible over parts of Spain. Flight IB1473 will deploy an Airbus A321XLR departing from Madrid-Barajas International Airport (MAD) at 18:45 local time, following a tailored route over Palencia province at an altitude of 10,000 meters. Carrying researchers from the Shelios scientific program, the airline intends to stream the eclipse live on social media via SpaceX's Starlink satellite internet connection onboard the aircraft.
body: Spanish flag carrier Iberia will operate a special charter flight on August 12, 2026, to observe the total solar eclipse visible over parts of Spain. Designated as flight IB1473 in reference to the birth year of astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus, the flight is scheduled to depart from Madrid-Barajas International Airport at 18:45 local time.

The mission will utilize an Airbus A321XLR operating at an altitude of 10,000 meters along a flight path over Palencia province in north-central Spain. The aircraft will carry a scientific research team participating in the Shelios program, led by astronomer Miquel Serra-Ricart. Additionally, Javier Meana Fernández, one of the pilots onboard, holds a background in astrophysics.

Iberia plans to broadcast the astronomical observation live across its social media channels. The A321XLR assigned to the flight is among the airline's first aircraft equipped with satellite-based Starlink internet connectivity provided by SpaceX.

zh.title: Joby規劃2026年9月於德州展開首批eVTOL試飛
zh.summary: Joby Aviation於2026年8月5日公布第二季財報時表示，預計將於2026年9月在德州展開美國「eVTOL整合試飛計畫」（eIPP）下的首次飛行任務。該公司同時維持在2026年底前載運首批乘客的目標，並持續推進美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的第五階段型別檢定作業。
body: 總部位於加州的電動垂直起降飛行器製造商 Joby Aviation 於 2026 年 8 月 5 日發布第二季財務報告時宣布，預計將於 2026 年 9 月在德克薩斯州展開美國「eVTOL 整合試飛計畫」（eIPP）架構下的首批飛行任務。該公司同時確認，將持續維持在 2026 年底前實現首次載客營運的既定目標。
美國「eVTOL 整合試飛計畫」（eIPP）是由行政命令設立，並由美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）與美國交通部於 2026 年 3 月 9 日選出首批八個合作項目。該計畫允許參與單位在與 FAA 直接簽署協議的框架下，操作尚未取得型別檢定證的航空器進行飛行，藉此累積實際營運資料，作為未來相關法規制定之參考依據。
在德克薩斯州的試飛計畫中，該項目由德克薩斯州交通廳主導，參與企業除了 Joby Aviation 之外，還包括 Archer Aviation、Beta Technologies 以及 Wisk。該計畫旨在建立連接達拉斯、奧斯汀與聖安東尼奧的空中交通網路，並規劃未來進一步擴展至休士頓。
在認證進度方面，Joby Aviation 正處於 FAA 型別檢定的第五階段兼最終階段。該公司自 2026 年 3 月 11 日展開首架符合型別檢查授權設計標準的飛機 N547JX 試飛以來，目前已有 5 架航空器投入飛行測試，另有 12 架正在生產線中，並預計在 2026 年內再完成 2 架飛機的交付。
在財務表現方面，Joby Aviation 報告第二季來自其於 2025 年收購的直升機營運商 Blade 的營收為 3620 萬美元，並將 2026 全年營收預測調升至 1.15 億美元至 1.25 億美元之間。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，該公司持有 23 億美元的現金與短期投資，並預估在 2026 年下半年使用 3.85 億美元至 4.15 億美元資金。

en.title: Joby Targets September 2026 for First US eVTOL Pilot Flights in Texas
en.summary: Joby Aviation announced on August 5, 2026, alongside its second-quarter financial results, that it expects to launch its first flights under the US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) in Texas in September 2026. The California-based manufacturer maintained its operational target to carry its first passengers before the end of 2026. The eIPP framework enables participants to fly uncertified aircraft under dedicated agreements with the Federal Aviation Administration to gather operational data for future rulemaking. Joby also reported entering the fifth and final stage of FAA type certification, with five aircraft currently flying and twelve more in production.
body: California-based Joby Aviation announced on August 5, 2026, alongside its second-quarter financial results, that it expects to launch its first flights under the US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) in September 2026, with initial operations planned in Texas. The electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft developer also confirmed that it maintains its target of flying its first passengers before the end of 2026.

Established under a presidential executive order, the eIPP saw its first eight projects selected by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the US Department of Transportation on March 9, 2026. The program permits participants to fly aircraft that have not yet obtained FAA type certification under specialized agreements negotiated directly with the agency, enabling companies to collect operational data to support future aviation rulemaking.

The Texas eIPP initiative is led by the Texas Department of Transportation and includes Joby Aviation alongside industry partners Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies, and Wisk. The project aims to establish regional aerial connections linking Dallas, Austin, and San Antonio, with plans to later expand connections to Houston.

Joby reported significant progress in its type certification journey, currently navigating the fifth and final stage of FAA certification. Since beginning flight testing of its first conforming aircraft, registered N547JX, on March 11, 2026, Joby now has five aircraft actively flying and twelve additional units in production, with plans for two further deliveries before the end of 2026.

On the financial side, Joby recorded $36.2 million in second-quarter revenue generated by Blade, the helicopter charter operator it acquired in 2025. Consequently, the company raised its full-year 2026 revenue forecast to between $115 million and $125 million. As of June 30, 2026, Joby held $2.3 billion in cash and short-term investments, and projects cash usage between $385 million and $415 million during the second half of the year.

zh.title: 達美航空10月開航亞特蘭大至利雅德 首條沙烏地航線預訂疲軟推折扣
zh.summary: 達美航空已確認將於 10 月正式開航亞特蘭大往返利雅德的航班服務。由於這條身為達美航空首度開闢的沙烏地阿拉伯航線預訂表現「比預期疲軟」，航空公司目前已開始針對該航線推出機票折扣優惠。
body: 達美航空已確認將於 10 月正式開航亞特蘭大至利雅德的航線服務。該項新服務為達美航空開闢的首條沙烏地阿拉伯航線。
然而在開航前的市場銷售方面，該航線的預訂表現未達預期。針對機票預訂情況出現「比預期疲軟」（softer than anticipated）的情形，達美航空已針對該航線推出機票折扣優惠。
達美航空選擇在 10 月開航前祭出折扣，主因在於該條首開沙烏地阿拉伯航線的初始訂位狀況低於預估，航空公司希望藉此因應預訂疲軟的市場反應。

en.title: Delta Discounts Atlanta-Riyadh Route Amid Softer Demand Ahead of October Launch
en.summary: Delta has confirmed an October launch date for its new direct flight service connecting Atlanta and Riyadh, marking the carrier's first-ever route to Saudi Arabia. However, following initial advance passenger booking levels that have been described by the airline as softer than anticipated, Delta has begun offering ticket discounts on the new sector. The fare discounts come as the airline prepares for the official start of the Atlanta-Riyadh service.
body: Delta has confirmed an October launch date for its upcoming service between Atlanta and Riyadh. The scheduled route represents the carrier's first-ever service to Saudi Arabia, establishing a direct connection between Atlanta and Riyadh.

Ahead of the scheduled inauguration, customer demand for the route has been below expectations. In response to advance bookings described as softer than anticipated, Delta has instituted ticket discounts for the Atlanta-Riyadh route.

The pricing adjustments come as the airline prepares for the confirmed October launch date of its first-ever Saudi Arabia service, addressing initial booking levels that proved softer than anticipated.
